milestones.title: Evidence-first portfolio published
milestones.narrative: First public version of the portfolio, built as a static site from a public snapshot contract: claims are stored separately from evidence, and every capability statement points at something a reader can inspect.

milestones.title: Evidence boundaries written down
milestones.narrative: Each public reproduction gained an explicit boundary: what it demonstrates and, in the same list, what it does not. Documented for the cloud dashboard reproduction, the AI reliability lab and the automation workflow lab, together with deployment ownership notes and a documented products quickstart.

milestones.title: Dark-first theme foundation
milestones.narrative: Theme assets were split out of the pages into a shared foundation and the homepage was recomposed around evidence rather than marketing copy, keeping the dark-first default.

milestones.title: Bilingual EN/ES release and accessibility parity
milestones.narrative: Reviewed English and Spanish locales shipped across the site, followed by homepage parity and accessibility polish so both languages expose the same content and the same interactive affordances.

milestones.title: Portfolio 10x rebuild starts
milestones.narrative: Redesign kicked off with a research artifact covering dark-first dual-theme tokens, type scale, motion rules and an accessibility checklist, replacing the previous text-heavy layout. The Astro scaffold and canonical data layer follow in this task; the legacy static site stays live until the cutover gate.
